senses.gloss: to do something by accident; to happen.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 33a:7">Snh. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ ועבד כחד וכ׳</he> if he happened to act in accordance with the opinion of one of them, when the common usage agrees with the other.
<cite ref="Ketubot 26a:5">Keth. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיקְּרוּ ויהבו ליה</he> accidentally they gave it to him.
